psychological_meaning: Abbey, a muted gray, evokes feelings of neutrality, sophistication, and calmness. It is often associated with practicality, stability, and a sense of quiet confidence. This color suggests a lack of extremes, promoting a balanced and dependable atmosphere. Abbey can also convey a sense of formality and understated elegance.
